caption: This is why I stopped buying store-bought snacks 🤍 Simple, homemade, and made with real ingredients. Apple Sauce Muffins Ingredients: • 3 eggs • 200 g unsweetened applesauce • 150 g flour • 5 g baking powder • 100 g dark chocolate chips Instructions: Mix eggs and applesauce. Add flour and baking powder. Fold in chocolate chips. Bake at 360°F for 25 minutes. — Easy, soft, and perfect for kids 🤍 If you want snacks and meals planned for you like this… 👉 Find MunchMind in my bio #toddlersnacks #muffins #healthysnacks #babyledweaning #toddlermealideas
